messages:
marta: Quick thing — customer X hit the Dedicated quota limit and our SREs couldn't tell if their tenant admin or an internal service bumped quota. Can we add clearer entitlements for 'quota override' in the console?

devin: +1 we have no fine-grained surface for who can change per-route quotas. Right now it's just 'Edit route' which is too coarse.

devin: API sample: ```PATCH /routes/:id {"quota_limit": 8000} headers: X-Entitlements: ["quota_override"] ```

ryan: From infra side, we need audit + per-route enforcement. I'd prefer an entitlement that can be assigned at tenant or role level: `quota_override`.

sania: UX idea — show an 'Effective quota' preview next to the limit with a small 'overrides' badge listing identities that have active overrides. Click to expand.

kevin: Security note: any override must create an immutable audit event and optionally require 2nd approval for enterprise tenants. Also KMS/HSM not relevant but log integrity is.

olga: API question: should we add an `entitlements` array to the route proto or a separate `route_permissions` resource? Adding to route object is simpler for console but pollutes model.

devin: Debate: route_permissions resource would let us version permissions independent of route lifecycle. But it increases reads on the route list; we could batch fetch.

marta: For rollout we want canary: show entitlement UI in console beta for 10% of tenants and record telemetry: `ui.quota.override.view`, `ui.quota.override.click`, `api.quota.override.attempt`.

ryan: Telemetry needs sampling thresholds. For auditable events (override success/fail) no sampling; for UI impressions we can sample 1% by default, 5% for enterprise. We'll add those to the events doc.

sania: Small mock: `Effective quota: 8k tokens / month (overridden by: tenant-admin@example.com, service-account:billing)` with a `Preview` link.

kevin: Also require feature flag `rbac.quota_override_v1` and a guard in `/routes` PATCH that returns 403 if caller lacks `quota_override` entitlement.

olga: I'll open a PR to add the entitlement to the permissions service and add a `quota_override` permission to the role schema. Will include migration plan and a script to backfill existing admin overrides as audit records.

marta: Cool. Action items: olga -> PR for permissions + migration; devin -> console mock + beta flag; ryan -> add audit + telemetry rules; sania -> final microcopy. We'll sync end of week. :thumbsup:
